guarantees.claim: When round_key_sel equals ROUND_KEY_DIRECT, round_key is driven to key_bytes directly.
When round_key_sel equals ROUND_KEY_MIXED and CiphOpFwdOnly is false, round_key is driven to key_mix_columns_out.
When round_key_sel equals ROUND_KEY_MIXED and CiphOpFwdOnly is true, round_key is driven to key_bytes (bypassing key_mix_columns_out).
For any round_key_sel value not matching the two explicit cases, round_key defaults to key_bytes.

assumptions.claim: round_key_sel must take only the two legal enum values ROUND_KEY_DIRECT or ROUND_KEY_MIXED during normal operation.
assumptions.risk: If round_key_sel takes an illegal value (e.g., due to SEU or logic bug), the default path silently drives key_bytes, potentially using an unmixed key when a mixed key was intended. The unique case pragma will trigger a simulation violation but synthesis may just treat default as unreachable.

assumptions.claim: key_mix_columns_out must be valid and stable whenever round_key_sel == ROUND_KEY_MIXED and CiphOpFwdOnly is false, since it is combinatorially forwarded to round_key.
assumptions.risk: Stale or invalid key_mix_columns_out would propagate directly to round_key, corrupting the round key used by downstream cipher logic.

uncertain_points.claim: unique case with a default that silently falls back to key_bytes may mask a fault-injected or bug-corrupted round_key_sel value. The design gives no error indicator when the default path is taken.
uncertain_points.cond: round_key_sel is neither ROUND_KEY_DIRECT nor ROUND_KEY_MIXED
uncertain_points.risk: A flipped bit in round_key_sel (e.g., from a fault attack) could cause the wrong key source to be used without any integrity alert, potentially enabling a differential side-channel or plaintext recovery attack.

uncertain_points.claim: The driver of round_key_sel and its timing relative to key_mix_columns_out validity are not visible in this chunk. A glitch on round_key_sel while key_mix_columns_out is changing could transiently expose a mixed/incorrect round_key value.
uncertain_points.risk: A transient combinatorial glitch on round_key could be latched downstream, producing a wrong round key for one cycle and causing silent ciphertext corruption.
